title: Resident Services Guidance — Pet Addendum Decision Period and Weight-Class Changes
content:
**Rule.** A complete Pet Addendum registration is decided within the business days to decide that its addendum type sets; a registration still incomplete after that period is denied and may be submitted again. The addendum type follows the animal: a dog whose recorded weight moves into another weight class is moved to that addendum type at its next document renewal.

### Questions the rule answers

**Within what time is a complete registration decided?**
Within the number of business days to decide that the Pet Addendum sets for the registration's addendum type. The period is counted in business days, not calendar days.

**What becomes of a registration that is still incomplete when that period has passed?**
It is denied. The denial does not close the matter permanently: the registration may be submitted again.

**A dog's recorded weight has changed. Which addendum type governs it?**
The addendum type follows the animal. Where the dog's recorded weight has moved into another weight class, the dog is moved to that class's addendum type at its next document renewal. Renewed vaccination documents and an updated veterinary weight are recorded against the animal's addendum.

**Does the move happen on the day the new weight is recorded?**
The rule places the move at the dog's next document renewal.

**Does a new weight that stays inside the current class move the dog?**
No. The move applies to a dog whose recorded weight moves into another weight class.

### Illustrations (hypothetical)

| Hypothetical situation | Result under the rule |
|---|---|
| A registration is complete on the second business day of a hypothetical three-business-day period | Decided within the period |
| A registration still lacks a required record when a hypothetical three-business-day period has passed | Denied; may be submitted again |
| A dog under a hypothetical 25.00 to 49.90 lb class has an updated veterinary weight of 52.0 lb recorded | Moved to the addendum type whose class contains 52.0 lb, at its next document renewal |
| A dog under the same hypothetical class has an updated veterinary weight of 47.0 lb recorded | Stays in its current addendum type |
